init.label: Tasks
init.cubeText: {"columns": [{"name": "task"}, {"name": "owner"}, {"name": "hours", "type": "number"}, {"name": "tags", "type": "string"}, {"name": "mine", "expr": "SUM(@hours)"}, {"name": "share", "expr": "SUM(@hours) / SUM(hours)"}, {"name": "rank", "expr": "RANK.EQ(SUM(@hours), BYROW(hours, LAMBDA(r, SUM(r))))"}, {"name": "owner total", "expr": "SUMIFS(BYROW(hours, LAMBDA(r, SUM(r))), owner, @owner)"}, {"name": "urgent", "expr": "COUNTIF(@tags, \"urgent\") > 0"}, {"name": "all tags", "expr": "TEXTJOIN(\", \", TRUE, UNIQUE(TOCOL(tags, 1)))"}], "rows": [{"task": "Design", "owner": "ana", "hours": [2, 3, 1.5], "tags": ["ui", "urgent"]}, {"task": "Build", "owner": "ben", "hours": [5, 6, 4, 7], "tags": ["backend"]}, {"task": "Test", "owner": "ana", "hours": [1], "tags": ["qa", "urgent", "ui"]}, {"task": "Ship", "owner": "cy", "hours": [], "tags": []}]}
